appeal_text: I am a Blue Badge holder and parked in the disabled bay outside outpatients. My badge was on the dashboard but must have slipped off when I shut the door. Photo of my badge attached.
My mother has a Blue Badge and I drove her to her eye clinic appointment. The badge was displayed but it was upside down. Please cancel the charge.
Parked in an accessible bay with my blue badge clearly visible. Your camera photo only shows the number plate AB12 CDE so of course you cannot see the dashboard.
I am disabled and my badge expired last week. The renewal is with the council and I have attached their confirmation email.
Charged for overstaying in the disabled bays at the retail park. As a badge holder I need longer to get round the shops and the bays did not say there was a time limit for badge holders.
My husband is a wheelchair user and holds a disabled badge. Every accessible bay was taken so we parked in a normal bay right by the entrance with his badge on display.
Blue Badge holder here. Reception told me badge holders do not need to register their car on the visitor tablet, so I didn't.
Disabled badge was displayed the whole time, badge number on the attached photo. Please look at your images again.
The signs at the entrance are completely covered by overgrown hedges. I had no idea this was a paid car park.
There is no sign anywhere near where I parked saying the maximum stay is 2 hours.
Your sign says free after 6pm. I was charged at 6:20pm. How is that right?
The writing on the signs is far too small to read from a car and there is no sign at the entrance at all.
The signs were changed last month to say permit holders only but the old sign by the trolley bay still says customer parking. Nobody would know.
The tariff board had been vandalised and was unreadable so I could not see how much to pay or what the rules were.
It was dark when I arrived and none of the signs are lit. There was no way to read any terms and conditions.
I parked on what looks like a public road. There was nothing to say it was private land.
I paid 3.50 through the app but you say there is no payment for AB12 CDE. My bank statement showing the payment is attached.
The pay machine was out of order and would not take card or coins. I tried twice.
I paid for my stay but typed my registration with the letter O instead of a zero. The payment was made at the correct time.
I have been charged twice. Once by the app for the parking and then this PCN saying I didn't pay.
The parking app crashed when I tried to pay and would not load for about 15 minutes. I paid as soon as it worked.
I paid at the machine with my card but it did not print a ticket. The payment shows on my card statement.
The app charged me under the wrong car park code because the location pin was wrong. I still paid in full.
My receipt shows I paid for 3 hours but your letter says I stayed 2 hours 40 minutes without paying.
The card reader said transaction declined three times but my bank says nothing was attempted. I left to get cash and came straight back.
I have a valid resident permit for bay 14. I got a new car last week and the e-permit has not been updated to the new registration yet.
I am a nurse here and have a staff permit. I was parked in the staff car park on a night shift.
My e-permit ran out on the 1st but I renewed online on the 2nd. The charge was issued on the 3rd.
My neighbour put in a visitor permit for me but he typed the wrong registration. Contact him on 07700 900123 to confirm.
I am a student with a university parking permit. I parked in zone B but my permit is for zone A because zone A was full.
I have a contractor permit from the housing association to carry out repairs at block C.
My tenancy includes a parking space and my landlord said a permit would be sent to me. It still has not arrived.
Our management company moved to a new permit system and my permit did not transfer across. Email me at j.patel@example.com.
I hold a permit for this car park but I was driving my partner's car that day, registration CD34 EFG.
My son had a severe asthma attack and I drove straight to A&E. Paying for parking was the last thing on my mind.
My car broke down in your car park and I waited three hours for recovery. The recovery report is attached.
My wife went into labour early and we rushed straight into the delivery suite.
I felt very unwell while shopping and was looked after in the first aid room for over an hour.
There was a gas leak at the shopping centre and everyone was evacuated. We were not allowed back to our cars.
My father passed away on the ward that afternoon and I stayed with my family. I could not think about moving the car.
I was in a minor collision at the car park entrance and had to wait for the other driver's insurer and the police.
I came back to a flat tyre and could not leave until it was changed.
I was not the driver at the time. My brother was using the car that week.
I sold this car two weeks before the date on your notice. The DVLA confirmation is attached.
I was only in the car park for 6 minutes to drop off a parcel. That is within any reasonable grace period.
A 100 pound charge for 10 minutes is excessive and unfair.
My car has been cloned. I was in Leeds, 200 miles away, on the day of this charge.
The photos show a different car to mine. Same plate but a different make and colour.
The car park was full so I drove in and straight back out. Your cameras logged it as a 12 minute stay.
I never received the first letter, only this one from a debt collector.
